rules: Use compact for revision, status, blockers, budgets, explorer_assignments and separate execution/conclusion statuses; full returns stored references without expanding them.

rules: Preserve the result as agent_selection in role_register.
For Claude Code supply the observed available_agents.

check_run.summary: Reconcile the full registered check set, executing only checks without applicable passing evidence.
rules: Baseline precedes implementation in a clean worktree; self/independent/integration require a frozen local commit.
Integration is a legacy API stage. The transfer workflow retains worktree evidence and does not dispatch checks again.

Reuse requires the same task/run, stage, clean source and execution definition. New logs retain their executed subset and original registry revision; reused_evidence points to original logs without relabeling them. An entirely reused result has log=null.

Only a registered matching explorer checks assignment may run; timeout covers the full assigned attempt including prior deterministic procedures and setup/report capture, capped by assignment limits and any explicit absolute deadline.

check_setup.summary: Resolve planned setup/procedure after baseline while running or repairing.
rules: command is the exact executable argument array; keep existing checks and assertions.

checks_extend.summary: Add mandatory checks from the completed verification lens's gap or more_checks result.
rules: Supply exactly one basis: verification_result event ID or reviewer more_checks review_round.
Wait for the whole review round to finish. The latest failed/unavailable verification conclusion binds additions to criteria with a concrete check_request; a gap does not fabricate a test failure.

Preserve existing checks and budgets; increment registry revision, execute missing checks and obtain a new verification_result. Reuse unchanged executions and a passing code verdict for evidence-only additions. Preparing a changed candidate requires the full set and both fresh lenses. Preparation uses repair with the recorded gap as defect_evidence; it does not charge the independent-check failure counter.
Each addition has one exact command or existing contained procedure with scoped criteria; procedures require explicit execution_kind.
Refactoring IDs cannot reuse another task's registered, historical or planned generated check ID.

rules: Bind additional commands/procedures to the task acceptance criteria; keep required project checks.

rules: before is the exact applicable registry; after contains complete exact check records, including unchanged project checks.
Use the current task registry_revision; each changed payload needs a new revision and fresh checks/review.
Capture baseline first; use only running or reserved repair work with its assigned active executor.
preserves lists exactly the affected preserved criterion IDs. Their identity survives test moves.
Pending checks apply to this candidate; accepted checks stay confirmed for other tasks until atomic acceptance.
Failure/unavailability keeps the revision unconfirmed and retains repair/review budgets.
Changing approved obligations, groups or lifetimes requires spec_conflict/revised_plan.

integrate.summary: Serialize integration of the unchanged transfer into the execution branch.
rules: Preview detects conflicts before applying to the main tree. A conflict leaves that tree unchanged and returns next=worktree_refresh. Resolve in the replacement task worktree, freeze, run the full checks and both fresh reviews, then transfer again.
On successful transfer, freeze the recorded integration tree with candidate, then commit and accept. Retain original worktree checks, conclusion and review without repeating them.

procedure_begin.summary: Bind the procedure to the clean Git commit before its assigned role executes it.
rules: execution_kind belongs to the check record outside run: command defaults deterministic; procedure requires explicit deterministic. Manual and behavioral checks are rejected.

Deterministic begin starts or continues the full assignment attempt deadline; execute within returned remaining_timeout and check_deadline. Expired starts are rejected; over-budget results retain actual steps and reported_outcome but cannot pass.
Only Explorer executes assigned deterministic procedures. Reviewers execute no checks or procedures.

rules: Then check_run reconciles the full registry; edits during a procedure make evidence stale.

repair.summary: Reopen the assigned executor with evidence without increasing the failure counter.
rules: Supply defect_evidence unless a failure is already recorded. Only a completed failed independent check batch charges the task budget.
Executor self-checks are unrestricted by this budget. Unknown or out-of-scope ownership returns to sdd-spec before edits.

resume.summary: Reconcile admitted scope, Git and actual host liveness without discarding work.

resolution.abandon_procedures: all unfinished predecessor check IDs, when present
resolution.head: exact observed clean HEAD for execution_head_changed
resolution.compatible: true after inspecting compatibility of execution_head_changed with the saved execution instruction

rules: Resolve each lost role separately. A successor must name that predecessor and have the same task/kind.
Legacy resolutions may omit role_id: successor_of supplies the specific predecessor.

For a lost task explorer with pending procedures, resolution.abandon_procedures must list every unfinished check ID. Resume archives each predecessor attempt as abandoned with its trace; the successor starts a fresh procedure with the existing batch deadline and repair counters.
Task phase restores only after every task blocker is resolved; review and repair reservations survive.
Reconcile a compatible clean external HEAD autonomously using exact head and inspection evidence. Ask the user only for a substantive conflict with the authorized scope.
Refactoring returns check_registries with confirmed_revision/confirmed_checks and pending_transition separately; resume never confirms a revision.
Budget, normative and spec-conflict blockers require their dedicated operations.

rules: Candidate references are no longer accepted.
Verification requires its current verification_result and test_integrity covering assertions, skips/xfail and command weakening.
Code owns architecture and code rules: no test_integrity, more_checks, acceptance proof or criterion mappings. Verification does not report architecture findings.
One pass leaves the round pending. Both lenses and the criterion conclusion must pass before transfer.

rules: Both lenses must pass. Each newly launched lens uses a separate fresh context.

After more_checks, evidence-only additions reuse the passing code verdict when source, approved task and owned paths are unchanged. Start verification; the response lists reused_lenses and retains the original code review reference. A changed candidate or task contract requires both lenses again.

revised_plan.summary: Validate a newly approved basis while preserving accepted tasks and lifetime budgets.

accepted_scope.text: actual user decision to accept the current scope

rules: Stop/reconcile active roles first; completed tasks remain unchanged and new tasks append.

Retain checks, inventory, confirmed/pending registry history and conclusion history. Approved plan check changes append a registry revision; an incompatible pending transition rejects revision before effects. Old conclusions do not become current under the revised contract.

accepted_scope requires the unchanged frozen result in a live unintegrated worktree and a reformulated task. Retain the run and candidate, archive the original contract/results, preserve budgets, and enter verifying. Reuse unchanged executions but obtain fresh criterion assessment and both review lenses before normal acceptance. Other unfinished tasks return to pending.
instruction contains actual execution text and source authorizing the revised plan and any mapped follow-up.
Each completed_followups mapping replaces only that accepted task's obsolete budget stop with a new approved dependent task; counters and unrelated blockers remain.
Unfinished tasks and active review/repair reservations cannot use completed_followups. Retain historical check records for inspection.

Reviewers require lens_id and separate fresh contexts for each lens; launch only after all project tests and static checks pass.
A lost-role successor names successor_of; resume resolves that specific predecessor and lens.
